desc: Custom-Tune Spring Kits are designed to easily and inexpensively improve your revolver's action and functionality. These quality spring kits feature the finest gun springs available, made from high tensile spring wire for the finest possible action tuning jobs. Kits include the various springs necessary to assure reliable function, smooth operation, consistency and long life. When only the best will do, Wilson Combat Custom-Tune spring kits are the only choice.
